rules.name: Purchase order number required
rules.description: Every purchase order record must include a non-empty purchase order number.

rules.name: Store identifier required
rules.description: Store (site) identifier is required for Walmart PO reconciliation.

rules.name: Must-arrive date not before order date
rules.description: Must-arrive date must be on or after the order date.

rules.name: Cancelled PO has no open quantity
rules.description: When status is Cancelled, open order quantity must be zero on all lines.

rules.name: Unique line keys within PO
rules.description: Line number and item identifier combination must be unique within the PO.
